subject.title: feishu plugin does not implement capabilities.inlineButtons; ask_user choice card silently downgrades to plain text on feishu DM

question: Should Feishu DM become a supported native `ask_user` question-card transport, rather than remaining presentation-only with corrected guidance?
rationale: Current context establishes an interaction gap and a proposed implementation, but not a maintainer-approved Feishu channel contract or the intended compatibility behavior for existing deployments.

options.title: Sponsor native question cards
options.body: Adopt the linked PR direction only after a scoped review and current Feishu DM proof of render, callback, resolution, and delivery tracking.

options.title: Keep presentation-only behavior
options.body: Retain Feishu as presentation-only and remove or correct any prompt/config guidance that implies inline `ask_user` choices are available.

recommendation.title: Sponsor native question cards
recommendation.body: Adopt the linked PR direction only after a scoped review and current Feishu DM proof of render, callback, resolution, and delivery tracking.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the reproduction and concrete candidate implementation, though repository ownership is not established by the available evidence.
